Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2005
ACT IX OF 2005
Pakistan
Navy (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act
further to amend the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Pakistan Navy (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 53, Ordinance XXXV of 1961

ACT IX OF 2005
ACT IX OF 2005

Navy (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act
further to amend the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
2. Amendment of section 53,
Ordinance XXXV of 1961.--In the
Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961 (XXXV of 1961), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, in section 53, after the word "imprisonment" at the
end, the words "and shall also be liable to fine" shall be added.
